question: If the measure of each exterior angle of a regular polygon is 30°, then the number of sides of the polygon is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ For any **regular polygon**, the number of sides (n) is directly related to the measure of its **exterior angle**. Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior Angle n = 360° ÷ 30° = 12 **∴ The correct answer is 12.**
